subject: Opsly on‑prem architecture deep‑dive — aligning calendars
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@opsly.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Opsly on‑prem architecture deep‑dive — aligning calendars

Hi Michael —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: Opsly wants an isolated on‑prem deployment that preserves your existing VPC networking policies, integrates with your internal KMS, and can meet a 99.9% inference latency SLA for 4s p95 on your peak workloads. You also flagged procurement timelines and SOC2 evidence as gating items.

Next step: schedule a focused architecture deep‑dive with our infra engineers so we can map network/NAT requirements, quantify capacity (GPU footprint + batching profile), and confirm KMS/Key policies. Suggested agenda (30–45m):
- Intro & goals (5m)
- Current infra constraints / compliance checklist (10m)
- Deployment topology options (VPC peering vs. transit) (10m)
- Integration points: KMS, logging, audit export (10m)
- Action items / next steps (5m)

I've attached a short outline that our infra team will use. If you can share your preliminary requirements sheet (network CIDR ranges, egress policies, KMS provider) ahead of the call that will help us prepare.

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Tue Apr 6, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Apr 7, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Apr 8, 09:30–10:15

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-onprem-arch-outline.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
From: Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@opsly.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: opsly-arch-team@opsly.com
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opsly on‑prem architecture deep‑dive — aligning calendars

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap and the outline — that looks good. We can share the prelim requirements; attaching an internal spreadsheet that lists CIDRs and current KMS setup. A few notes from our side:
- Primary cluster is behind a NAT with restricted egress (will need an outbound proxy)
- We use HashiCorp Vault for key management; our security team will want details on how keys are referenced/rotated
- Compliance: we can provide SOC2 artifacts but would like to understand log retention options before committing

Of the slots listed, Wed Apr 7, 14:00–14:45 PDT works best for our architects. Please confirm and send a calendar invite.

Michael Barnes
Head of Infrastructure
Opsly
[Attachment: opsly-prelim-requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 64KB)]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, opsly-arch-team@opsly.com
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opsly on‑prem architecture deep‑dive — aligning calendars

Thanks Michael — Wed 2027‑04‑07 14:00 PDT is locked. Calendar invite sent (check for a separate invite from me).

Quick prep items for the Opsly team so we can run the session efficiently:
- Share your Vault key access pattern or a short example of how service accounts request keys (redacted if needed)
- Network: CIDR ranges + egress proxy details (already attached — thanks)
- Expected concurrent QPS and typical sequence lengths (helps with GPU sizing and batching)

Dev and Grace — joining you both to lead the topology discussion and sizing portion. I'll run the agenda and capture action items.

If the security folks want a separate 15‑minute follow up after the main call to go through SOC2 artifacts, we can schedule that before EOD next week.

Best,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao | Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Michael / team —

Thanks — looking forward to the session on Wed. I’ll prepare two topology sketches (VPC peering and secure transit gateway) and bring an initial GPU sizing estimate based on the QPS you shared in the spreadsheet. After the call we’ll upload a short write‑up with recommended next steps and a proposed pilot timeline.

Agenda reminder in the invite: topology options, KMS integration, logging/audit export, pilot timing.

See you Wed.

Regards,

Staff Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
